name: SolarOS – Solar EPC Lead to Proposal: Bill OCR, System Sizing, PM Surya Ghar Subsidy, ROI PDF & Site Survey Booking

parameters.content:
## ☀️ SolarOS – Rooftop Solar Lead to Proposal

For solar EPC companies in India whose sales team spends a day per lead reading the electricity bill, sizing the system, working out the PM Surya Ghar subsidy and building a proposal. By then the homeowner has already heard from three competitors.

### How it works
A lead sends a photo of their electricity bill on WhatsApp or through a web form. GPT-4o reads the units, tariff and sanctioned load. The workflow sizes the system, applies the PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and works out 25-year savings, payback and EMI. The AI writes the proposal copy, and a branded PDF is sent back on WhatsApp within a minute, along with a site-survey booking link. Sales gets a lead-score alert.

When the lead books, reschedules or cancels the survey on Cal.com, the CRM is updated, the lead gets a confirmation, and the site engineer is briefed with the address and system size.

### Setup steps
1. Connect WhatsApp Business Cloud (trigger and send), OpenAI, Google Sheets and Google Drive.
2. Run Gotenberg (`docker run gotenberg/gotenberg:8`) where n8n can reach it, and update its URL if needed.
3. Create a **Leads** sheet and a Drive folder for proposals, and replace the `REPLACE_WITH_…` IDs and phone numbers.
4. Edit `CFG` in **Size System, Subsidy & ROI** with your company details, prices per kW and Cal.com link.
5. Point a Cal.com webhook at **On Cal.com Survey Booking**, then send a test bill.

## 💬 WhatsApp Intake
A lead messages your WhatsApp number. Delivery receipts are ignored. If they sent a bill photo it's downloaded; if not, they're asked for one, and the photo they send back starts a fresh run.

## 📝 Web Form Intake
Leads from your website upload the bill with their name, phone, property type and roof area.

## 🔎 Bill OCR
GPT-4o reads the bill (any DISCOM or language) for units, tariff category, sanctioned load and the consumption history. Bi-monthly bills are converted to monthly. Unreadable or low-confidence bills get a polite request for a clearer photo.

## ☀️ Sizing, Subsidy & Proposal
Sizes the system from yearly units and state solar yield, capped by sanctioned load and roof area. Applies the PM Surya Ghar subsidy (up to ₹78,000, more in special-category states) and works out 25-year savings, payback and EMI. Gotenberg then renders the PDF.

## 📲 Deliver & Hand Off
The proposal PDF is archived to Drive and sent on WhatsApp with a site-survey booking link. The lead is saved to the CRM sheet, and sales gets a HOT, WARM or NURTURE alert.

## 📅 Survey Booking
Cal.com posts here when a survey is booked, rescheduled or cancelled. The lead ID travels in the booking link, so it matches back to the CRM row.

## 🛠️ Scheduled or Cancelled
Booked surveys update the CRM, confirm the slot to the lead and brief the site engineer with the address and system size. Cancellations update the CRM and send a friendly rebooking nudge.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Bills carry the customer's name, address and consumer number, so keep the CRM sheet and Drive folder private. Add a Cal.com webhook secret before going live. Keep Gotenberg on your private network, not the internet.

parameters.formDescription: Upload your latest electricity bill and we'll WhatsApp you a personalised proposal with your subsidy and savings.

parameters.textBody:
=Hi {{ $json.name }} 👋☀️
To prepare your *free rooftop solar proposal* with your exact PM Surya Ghar subsidy and savings, please send a *clear photo of your latest electricity bill* (the full page, with the units and the consumption history visible).

=Hi {{ $json.name }}, we couldn't read your bill clearly 🙏 ({{ $json.ocr_issue }}).
Please send another photo: *flat, in good light, with the full page visible*, especially the *units consumed* and the *consumption history* table.

values.content:
You are a senior rooftop-solar consultant in India writing for a homeowner or business owner. Use ONLY the numbers given. Never change them.
Return ONLY JSON:
{"headline": string (max 12 words, include the system size and the monthly saving),
 "intro": string (2-3 warm, specific sentences referencing their bill and city),
 "why_now": [string] (3 bullets: subsidy, tariff hikes, payback),
 "faqs": [{"q": string, "a": string}] (4 short FAQs: net metering with their DISCOM, monsoon/cloudy days, maintenance, subsidy timeline via the PM Surya Ghar portal),
 "whatsapp_message": string (max 550 chars, English, friendly, with 2-3 emojis, key numbers, ends asking them to book a free site survey),
 "whatsapp_message_hi": string (same message in simple Hindi, max 450 chars)}

={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $json.name, city: $json.city, state: $json.state, discom: $json.discom, segment: $json.segment, monthly_units: $json.monthly_units, peak_month_units: $json.peak_month_units, system_kw: $json.calc.system_kw, panels: $json.calc.panels, gross_cost: $json.calc.gross_cost, subsidy: $json.calc.subsidy, net_cost: $json.calc.net_cost, monthly_bill_now: $json.calc.monthly_bill_now, monthly_savings: $json.calc.monthly_savings, bill_after: $json.calc.bill_after, payback_years: $json.calc.payback_years, savings_25y: $json.calc.savings_25y, emi: $json.calc.emi, offset_pct: $json.calc.offset_pct, caps: $json.calc.caps }) }}
